title: hybrid.rs: Queue eviction tie-breaker fails on timestamp wraparound
description: Line 365: Uses `Reverse(p.queued_at_ms)` to evict oldest packet on priority tie. With timestamp wraparound (every ~49 days), older packets (high ms values near u32::MAX) appear newer than packets queued after wraparound (low ms values near 0), causing wrong packet eviction. Should use wrapping age comparison instead.
